title: Esteban Rangel wins Webb County Treasurer in official canvass
excerpt: The Webb County Commissioners Court's official canvass confirms Esteban Rangel won the county treasurer's race with 38,508 votes, or 68.94 percent.
content:
The Webb County Commissioners Court has officially canvassed the November 3, 2026 election, and Esteban Rangel has won the Webb County Treasurer's race, defeating Liza Janette Pena.

Rangel, a Democrat, received 38,508 votes, or 68.94 percent, to Pena's 17,348 votes, or 31.06 percent, according to the certified returns. A total of 55,856 votes were cast in the race.

The canvass was adopted by the Commissioners Court on November 12, 2026, sitting as the canvassing board. Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina certified that the figures on the tally sheets correspond with the figures on the returns sheets, and Elections Administrator Jose Luis Castillo certified the returns as true and correct.

Sources:

  • Webb County — Canvass of November 3, 2026 Joint General Election, certified November 12, 2026
  • Webb County — Commissioners Court Special Meeting minutes, November 12, 2026
